headline: First Solar Applauds Comprehensive Section 232 Action on Polysilicon and Derivatives
summary: PHOENIX, August 06, 2026--First Solar, Inc. (Nasdaq: FSLR) ("First Solar" or "the Company") today voiced strong support for the Trump Administration’s action on imports of polysilicon and its derivatives under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act, a move aimed at loosening China's grip on a critical supply chain.
